stories.explanation: Revenue from Ryzen processors, Radeon GPUs and semi-custom SoCs for gaming consoles and PCs.
stories.signal: Major rebound in gaming and PC markets.
stories.description: The Client and Gaming segment revenue increased to $14.6 billion in 2025 from $9.6 billion in 2024, driven by strong demand for AMD Ryzen processors, Radeon 9000 Series GPUs, and semi-custom SoCs for game consoles.
_validation: Description verified against MD&A: Client and Gaming segment revenue of $14.6B increased by 51% compared to $9.6B in 2024

stories.explanation: Revenue from embedded processors for industrial and networking applications.
stories.signal: Slight decline due to mixed demand across end markets.
stories.description: Embedded segment revenue declined 3% to $3.5 billion in 2025 from $3.6 billion in 2024, as certain end market demand remained mixed across industrial and networking verticals.
_validation: Description verified against MD&A: Embedded net revenue of $3.5 billion decreased by 3% compared to net revenue of $3.6 billion in 2024
